objective: Continuation authorized by the owner on 2026-10-28 ('Yes, let's continue'), taking the recommendation of COPRIME-PAIRS-20261027-001: class-4 locality and flows. It serves the complexity program's coprime counting dichotomy (counting homomorphisms from 3-manifold groups into nilpotent-by-cyclic groups N x| C_r, r | p - 1, graded, class at most 4): COPRIME-PAIRS decided 63 interacting census algebras by gadget knots and left 113 of 850 open, the largest family being 26 class-4 algebras whose only failing clean-edge condition is (K), gamma_4 at an active character.
